title: Relay v11: contract cleanup and bump
lead: The relay contract reads as one consistent set of rules with each rule stated once, its JSON carries every role and keyed stop rules, and `RELAY_CONTRACT` is 11 with one `RELAY_CHANGES` entry covering every v1.17 rule change.
findings_note: owner contract review 2026-10-30 (slicer, adj, ork alignment)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the rule changes themselves (s391, s407, s409, s412 land them first), serving an older contract's text, any ork or adj change (ork files its own slice to accept v11), and the config pin fixes (s415).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The owner reviewed the v10 contract (`slicer ai relay`, `slicer ai relay-orchestrator`, `--json`) on 2026-10-30 while aligning slicer, adj and ork. Several v1.17 slices change rules a role follows, which under the bump rule (`src/slicer/ai.py`, comment above `RELAY_CONTRACT`) means v11. Owner decision 2026-10-30: bundle every v1.17 rule change into one v11, landed by this slice last in the `ai.py` series, and fold the review's cleanups into it so the text churns once. ork accepts only v9 and v10 today and files a companion slice to accept v11.

Review findings, each to fix here:

1. Stop lists "an owner decision marked `blocker` is needed" as a stop condition, while its parenthetical and the orchestrator Rules say ask with `relay-run ask`, wait and resume. The JSON `stop[]` carries the same item, so a program reading it would stop. Remove it from Stop and `stop[]`; state the blocker wait once as its own rule.
2. The Conformance stop bullet says "do not ask the owner", then gives an exception that asks the owner. Split it into a stop obligation and a blocker-wait obligation.
3. The gate criterion "no new `fix` finding of medium severity or worse" relies on a severity scale nothing defines; findings carry only a kind. Owner decision 2026-10-30: drop severity. Every `fix` finding fails the gate; a minor item is tagged `later`. Update the text and `gate.criteria` in the JSON.
4. Owner-answer routing is stated twice in `ai relay` (Order step 3 and the Owner answers paragraph). Keep one and point to it.
5. The foreground and long-command rules appear in Every brief, the orchestrator's Waiting rule and Conformance; "send the report once" appears in Waiting, Conformance and Run report (absorbs s418). State each once.
6. Reviewer independence is stated in Roles, matrix rules u1 and u2, Stop and Conformance. Keep the matrix rule and one reference.
7. The orchestrator's Waiting rule is the densest paragraph in the contract. Rewrite it as a short list without changing what it requires.
8. `roles[]` in `ai relay --json` has no `gate`; ork special-cases it. Add a `gate` role with `ledger_role` `gate`.
9. `stop[]` is free text. Give each stop rule a key (for example `gate_fail_3`, `spec_wrong`, `permission_denied`, `no_eligible_row`), as `conformance` has.
10. Setup says the orchestrator runs as agent type `relay-orchestrator` where the harness has one installed, and the comment above `RELAY_CONTRACT` cites the agents repo's `Expects:` doctor. Owner decision 2026-10-30: drop both. The orchestrator always runs as a general-purpose agent briefed with `slicer ai relay-orchestrator`; remove the agents-repo comment and the `orchestrator` Setup bullet's agent-type clause (and `docs/commands.md` where it repeats it).
11. The spec check and the orchestrator often have no matrix row; say plainly that an unmatched orchestrator means the outer session orchestrates (s412 item 1, if s412 has not already done it).
12. Stop: say a project with no role matrix stops on a vendor limit (absorbs s421), and make the Conformance `vendor_limit` wording match Stop's independence list (absorbs s422).
13. Vendor fallback follows ork. Owner decision 2026-10-30: ork's engine falls back to the next matching row on a round that exits with a vendor or harness error, not only a classified rate limit or out of credits (ork S169; a Claude limit classifies as `error`). The contract does the same: a role's round that ends in a rate limit, out of credits or an error exit of the agent process is recorded failed with its reason and rerun as a new step on a fresh agent on the next matching row, under the same independence rules; out of credits still skips later rows on the same vendor. A gate FAIL, a wrong spec or a permission denial is not an error exit and keeps its own rule. With no eligible row left, stop. Rename the conformance key only if its meaning changes (`vendor_limit` to `role_fallback`, say), and tell ork S198.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ai.py`: the relay and orchestrator texts, their shared sections, the JSON builders (`relay_contract`), `RELAY_CONTRACT` and `RELAY_CHANGES`.
- `tests/test_ai.py`, `tests/test_relay_conformance.py`, and the contract golden fixture.
- `docs/agents.md` (the `ai relay` JSON rows: `roles`, `stop`), `docs/working-with-agents.md` where it quotes the text, `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_AiRelay_Json_StopHasKeysAndNoBlockerWait`: every `stop[]` entry has `key` and `text`, and none describes a blocker owner question.
- `test_AiRelay_Json_RolesCarryGate`: `roles[]` has `gate` with `ledger_role` `gate`.
- `test_AiRelay_Text_StatesEachRuleOnce`: the foreground rule, owner-answer routing and report-once rule each appear once in each text.
- `test_AiRelay_Gate_EveryFixFindingBlocks`: the gate criteria name no severity; every `fix` finding fails the gate.
- `test_AiRelay_Fallback_CoversErrorExit`: Stop and Conformance rerun a round on the next row after an error exit as well as a limit, and still stop with no eligible row.
- `test_AiRelay_Text_NoAgentTypeOrAgentsRepo`: neither text names a `relay-orchestrator` agent type.
- `test_AiRelay_Contract_IsV11WithChangeEntry`: both texts start `Contract: relay v11` and `RELAY_CHANGES` ends with an entry for 11 that names each v1.17 rule change.
- Update the existing golden and conformance tests to the new text rather than deleting assertions.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. At claim, re-read the text as landed by s391, s407, s409 and s412.
2. Write the tests; watch them go red.
3. Edit the text and JSON. Keep Gate, Every brief, Stop and Conformance identical across both texts.
4. Bump to 11; write the `RELAY_CHANGES` entry from the rule changes of s391, s407, s409, s412 and this slice.
5. Update docs and CHANGELOG; mutation-check each new test.
6. Tell ork's companion slice the final JSON shape (a later note or a note on the ork item).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.
- `slicer ai relay --json` parses and carries `gate` in `roles` and keyed `stop`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
